brief: Sarah Jenkins (CFO) explained that any contract over $150k requires board sign‑off unless payments are amortized quarterly. She said that if the deal is structured with quarterly billing over 12 months, she can approve it within her executive threshold.

open_objections.text: Contracts over $150k need board sign‑off unless payments are amortized quarterly.

stakeholders.name: Sarah Jenkins
stakeholders.concerns: Board approval requirement for contracts >$150k; prefers quarterly billing over 12 months to stay within executive threshold.

promises.text: Will approve the contract under her executive threshold if quarterly billing over 12 months is provided.
